newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Long Distance in interconnect pact.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Long Distance in interconnect pact.

text.p: U.S. Long Distance Corp and Southwestern Bell, a unit of SBC Communications Inc, have signed an interconnection agreement under which U.S. Long Distance will provide local telephone service in Southwestern's operating area, the companies said Monday.

The agreement is the first to encompass all five states in Southwestern Bell's territory and the first to be reached in Kansas between Southwestern Bell and a competitive provider of local service, the companies said in a joint statement.
Southwestern Bell provides local service to Arkansas, Texas, Missouri, Oklahoma and Kansas.
